title: Magma Infusion
description: This Datapack makes the magma block burn the items it has on top once you throw the item a counter is put on top of the item when it reaches 10 the item disappears in a small explosion that does not hurt you or break anything but destroys the item
body:
## **Instructions:**

This datapack causes objects thrown on blocks of magma to burn up after 10 seconds. During that time, a counter appears over the object. At the end, the object disappears with a small visual explosion that does not cause damage or destroy blocks, just removes the object as if it had been burned.
